title: SlimeyBeats official immutable update manifest schema 1
description: Append as UPDATE-MANIFEST-<build_revision>.json on the fixed official GitHub release; never replace earlier assets. The highest canonical positive decimal u64 filename revision wins and must equal the payload build_revision. Leading zeros and malformed versioned names are rejected. UPDATE-MANIFEST.json is a legacy fallback only when no versioned manifest exists; invalid or unavailable selected manifests never fall back to older catalogs. UTF-8 JSON is limited to 65536 bytes. Versions must parse as SemVer; revisions must increase even when the version stays the same. No URLs are accepted. Optional component bundles support missing-helper recovery; normal installers already include those helpers.

version.description: Strict SemVer, without a leading v; build metadata does not affect version precedence.

notes.description: At most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; control characters other than tab, CR and LF are rejected.

components.description: Recommended IDs: mcp_windows_x86_64 and vst3_windows_x86_64. Duplicate JSON keys are rejected. Component consumers must check their supported protocol and safely extract only the listed entries.

installer_asset.description: Must contain the exact manifest version, optionally followed by a hyphenated release label, and end in -Setup.exe. Double dots, slashes, escapes, percent encoding, spaces and non-ASCII characters are forbidden.

asset.description: Exact release asset filename; no double dots, paths or percent escapes.

files.description: Exact relative ZIP entries, at most 240 ASCII bytes. Slash separators only; dot segments, reserved Windows names, case collisions and file/directory conflicts are forbidden. Duplicate keys are rejected.
